brief.text: The big story this morning is Viktor Gyokeres. Sky, the BBC gossip column, football.london and Football Italia all say he wants out, with Juventus and Milan circling, and Jose Mourinho has chipped in that he would have forced a move himself. That's a lot of smoke, but every one of those reports is still a rumour and nothing is close to a "here we go". On the pitch, Renee Slegers' Arsenal Women were held 1-1 by Birmingham City, while the under-18s won the north London derby 2-1 and a summer signing caught the eye. Elsewhere, an Arsenal player has owned up to causing Martin Zubimendi's injury, so watch for news on how bad it is, and Milan are reportedly plotting to beat Arsenal and Barcelona to Brugge's Tresoldi, which is another one to file under "wait and see".
